# Airbods v0.1.0-preview

Clean rewrite of the former AirPodsMode app.

- **Package:** `com.chinatsu.airbods` (installs beside old AirPodsMode — you may uninstall the old app)
- **UI:** Material 3 + Material You dynamic color, solid surfaces, rounded-square buttons
- **QS:** one tile named **Airbods** → Material mode panel
- **Features:** ANC / Transparency / Adaptive (+ 0/50/100), Conversational Awareness, last location on disconnect
- **Permissions:** Bluetooth + notifications (+ location for last place). Denying notifications does not crash; foreground connect still works.

## 中文
全新重写。包名 `com.chinatsu.airbods`，可与旧 AirPodsMode 并存。快捷设置仅保留一个 **Airbods** 磁贴。
